dataList.content:
What just happened? Everything went dark for a sec...
怎么回事？转眼之间变得一片漆黑……
dataList.place:
Wuthering Heights Corridors
呼啸山庄 走廊

dataList.content:
I think the lightning caused a brief power outage... the power's back now, though.
好像是因为雷击的影响导致的暂时停电……现在有电了。

What we just saw were...
还有刚刚看见的那片场景。果然……

... Catherine's memories, right?
是凯瑟琳小姐的记忆吧？

... I think so.
……好像是。

As it has been in the past, such occurrences can be attributed to the influence of the Golden Bough.
看来和上次一样，是金枝的影响。

Hold on. This is...
而且等等……这里是……

... This is the corridor we walked through earlier, isn't it? This isn't where we were before the power outage.
我们之前经过的走廊……吧？不是我们刚才所在的地方。

<I don't see Hindley or Linton anywhere, either.>
<亨德利和林顿也不在这。>

Oh my word... what just happened...?
怎么会……这是发生了什么……？

But... we didn't, like, take a step or anything, did we?
但是……我们一步也没动啊，对吧？

Mm. I do not believe that any of our fellows have moved.
嗯。没有人移动脚步。

If we were all standing still, then I suppose this means that it's the house that moved!
那就是说移动的不是我们，是这栋房子对吧？

What the... Know anything about this, Nelly?
你……对此有什么头绪吗，耐莉小姐？

I-I haven't the slightest idea.
我……我也一无所知。

I have been away from this manor for many years myself. I seldom had any reason to return ever since Miss Catherine married Master Linton and left this place to live with him.
因为我也很久没有来过这座宅邸了。自从凯瑟琳小姐和林顿大人结婚而离开之后，我也没什么机会到这里来。

Catherine, the deceased... didn't someone mention that she purchased this manor, Wuthering Heights?
你不是说那位叫凯瑟琳的逝者购入了呼啸山庄宅邸吗？

Yes, indeed. But she did not immediately move here after the purchase.
是的，但是只是购入了而已，并没有马上搬到呼啸山庄来。

Oh! Now that you mention it... I see that some changes have been made to this manor since I was gone.
啊！仔细一看……和离开之前相比宅邸各处都有改变。

Nelly was probably referring to the numerous exposed cables, holes, and cracks that seemed to have been painted over.
和耐莉说的一样，宅邸内处处残留着缠结的电线和修补的痕迹。

Had I been the Chief Butler of this manor... I would not have let such slovenliness slide.
在我还是首席管家时看到这副样子，肯定会大发雷霆，大叫怎么可以这样管理宅邸。

But...
但是……

Maybe she was trying to make modifications to the manor?
他们是想改造这座宅邸吗？

Is it normal for rich folks to just buy a whole manor and modify it to their liking?
一般而言，有钱人购入宅邸后按自己喜好改造这种事常见吗？

Mm... I'd say it's kinda like changing your hairstyle once in a while!
嗯……和换发型感觉差不多吧？

Maintaining the exact same style of hair for too long gets pretty boring, you know~
毕竟一直留着同一种发型会腻的。

Uh-huh. So that's how, uh, casual a full-on house remodeling is like for rich folks. I see.
啊哈~有钱人是这样的吧，我懂啦。

Heathcliff...
希斯克利夫……

I hardly know what to tell you. I do not know what words could possibly comfort you now.
虽然我不知道该对你说什么……

But what you said about Miss Catherine's death... and how you didn't believe that she was truly dead...
但是对于你说你不相信凯瑟琳小姐的死。

... What.
……啊。

... I gave that idea some thought.
我听完那句话重新想了想……

And I agree. To an extent.
某种程度上有点同意。

... What?
……什么？

Heathcliff's pupils suddenly dilated.
希斯克利夫瞬间瞪大了眼睛。

Even I... haven't seen Miss Catherine's body.
我也……还没有见到凯瑟琳小姐的遗体。

I was so beside myself when Master Linton told me of Miss Catherine's passing... that I did not even care to verify it with my own eyes.
只听到林顿家主说小姐去世了，慌乱之下也没有想到要去确认。

So what you're trying to say here is...
你的意思也就是说……

Uh... is it really what I think it is? You're saying that Cathy might... still be alive?
呃，所以。是我想的那样吗？凯茜她……可、可能没死……

Nothing but a suspicion at this point. ... Besides, you know how Miss Catherine can be.
只是觉得……万一。而且你也知道凯瑟琳小姐的性格。

Stubborn as a mule, sometimes doing things so unexpected that they're almost frightening...
比谁都要固执……有时候干出的事难以预料到令人毛骨悚然的地步……

Honestly, I even wondered if this whole funeral business was but an awful, elaborate jest from the Miss.
其实我甚至想过这场葬礼有没有可能，只是小姐准备的一场残忍的恶作剧。

What's certain is, however, that the will was undeniably in her own handwriting.
不过可以确信的是，那份遗嘱上是小姐的字体。

And Master Linton, he... never once stopped making modifications to the manor...
而且林顿家主……在凯瑟琳小姐去世后……

... even after Miss Catherine passed.
也没有停止对这座宅邸的改造。

That bastard Linton made these modifications to the manor?
这些事都是林顿那混蛋干的？

Yes. I haven't gotten a good look at this place, nor did I personally ask him of his motives, but...
嗯，虽然没有仔细看过……或者询问他的意图。

... it is quite evident that something is to transpire here, isn't it? ... Or that something had already happened.
但是至少……能确信这里会有什么事情发生……或者发生过什么事。

Bollocks... I don't understand any of this.
妈的……这到底是怎么一回事。

What do you think the 'lightning' in her will is talking about?
遗嘱上的……闪电代表着什么呢？

Maybe she meant it literally. Seven lightning strikes.
会不会就是字面意思上的七道闪电？

Are you suggesting that she knew we would arrive precisely under this weather, on the day of her funeral? Unless she moonlighted as a renowned prophet, I don't see that happening.
她怎么确信我们会在什么时候，在天气怎样时登门。若不是什么著名的预言家，不可能把那种事情当做条件。

Who knows? I don't even understand what Miss Catherine was trying to do here with that will.
没人会懂的……我们连凯瑟琳小姐到底想干什么也搞不懂……

Right... We can't... ever know the will of the dead.
对啊……怎么可能……知道已死之人在想些什么呢。

Perhaps there is something, a clue, to be found in Miss Catherine's room?
去凯瑟琳小姐的房间找找怎么样？

She did visit Wuthering Heights from time to time, even after her marriage to Master Linton.
小姐在结婚后也常常拜访呼啸山庄。她有可能在房间留了一些东西。

Don't you remember, Heathcliff? Miss Catherine...
你还记得吗，希斯克利夫？凯瑟琳小姐她……

... Yeah. She always liked riddles.
嗯，她总喜欢给人出谜题。

Not like you, who preferred a more... direct approach. Which involved smashing everything to pieces.
而你则是不喜欢动脑子，总是想着先全都打碎再说。

Got me in plenty of trouble for trying to brute force problems without even trying to think about the intent.
我后面被骂得可惨了。说我不了解谜题的意图就想着要动粗来解决。

A faint smile appeared on Heathcliff's face as he seemed to recall a fond memory...
希斯克利夫像是想起了过去，短暂地露出了微笑……

... I don't know if I've gotten any better at it since.
如今……也不知道能不能解开。

But the heavy, somber expression soon returned.
悲伤而沉重的表情随即就回到了他的脸上。

<I guess... our next order of things is to find where that room is.>
<总之……要先找到那个房间才行。>
